item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las dang po dbang lung thob tshul
item.coloph: de ltar rnal 'byor kho bo yang / sngon gyi las 'phro sad pa yi/ mkha' spyod o rgyan gnas su phyin/ rig 'dzin yab sras rnams dang mjal/ snyan rgyud dbang lung thob tshul gyi rnam thar gsal byed sgron ma 'di/ dad ldan slob mas rab bskul nas/ shel le rgya skar gnas mchog tu/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'di/ bka' skyongs gnyan la bzod par gsol/ bsgrub (sgrub) rgyud bstan pa dar ba dang / lam bar chod med par mthar phyin nas/ sku gsum ye shes gnas mchog thob shog gnyis pa snyan du brgyud tshul dang*/ gsum pa bka' rgya bkrol tshul ni gzhan du gsal lo//
